message:
You know that one friend who always panics when the lights flicker? 🙈 I like to think of myself as the calm one in those moments! Having a little plan for power outages can really help keep the peace. The Red Cross has some great tips on how to prepare for blackouts, from stocking up on essentials to keeping your devices charged. It’s all about feeling a bit more at ease when things go dark.
